flaws: Flight mechanics / path smoothness: On final approach to the landing pad (clearly visible in the chase and top views), the trajectory overshoots the center of the pad and makes a sharp hook/loop back to settle, rather than decelerating smoothly onto the target.

Flight mechanics / gate alignment: In the top-down view, the trajectory weaves in a pronounced S-curve and passes through the gates at an oblique angle near the inner frames (especially Gate 3) instead of aligning perpendicular to the gate planes.

Visual / camera framing: In the 'top' camera view, the room is rotated at a 45-degree diamond angle and the top/bottom corners of the bounding box are clipped off-screen; an orthographic or better-fitted axis-aligned top-down view would read much cleaner.

Visual / 3D label placement and legibility: In the 'low' camera view, the 3D text labels ('GATE 1', 'GATE 2', 'GATE 3') stack and overlap directly on top of each other, and the 'LAND' label intersects with the quadcopter mesh and path tube in the chase view.
parsed.summary: A very solid first round with a 100% pass rate (16/16), fast completion time (7.88s), and clean minimalist styling. To reach a 9+ polish level, smooth out the terminal landing overshoot and S-curve gate approaches in the controller, and fix the 3D label collisions and top-camera clipping.
